extracted.name: Butter cake
extracted.description: This one so moist, rich and aromatic. must try easy and simple ingredients.
instruction_lines: Battered mixer eggs, sugar emulsifier (always in the beginning) medium speed until rich texture.
Add vanilla extract, fouetté butter, canola oil, water
Hand mix with spatula approximately 2 minute all dry ingredients;milk powder, flour, baking powder.
Preheat oven 150c or 305F 30-45 minute depand on your oven check gradually after 25minute.
Cool completely before frosting or garnish.
